result.summary: All 11 acceptance criteria across ISS-0815, ISS-0814, ISS-0811, and ISS-0809 are COVERED. No TBD or deferrals (§7 None). Wire shapes unambiguously derived from backend source of truth with key sets and file/line references. Status casing rationale is complete and traceable. No new implementation code authored by CODE-DESIGNER — all code blocks in the document quote or reference already-committed code in named commits. Implementation code check PASS for retroactive artefact.
result.next_action: Route to FRONTEND-DEV (Step 2b) — all four issues are frontend-only changes. No ELIXIR-DEV (Step 2a) step required as no backend changes are in scope.

AC1_user_matches_user_map.evidence: §1.3 required fields (id, username, display_name, email, status, auth_source, inserted_at, updated_at) = exactly 8 keys from §1.1 user_map/1 source-of-truth quote.

AC2_timestamp_field_decision.evidence: §1.3 uses inserted_at: string in required section. Decision recorded in §1.3: backend has no created_at key, no migration planned, UsersPage.tsx Created column now reads u.inserted_at.

AC3_roles_field.evidence: §1.3 roles?: string[] (optional). Decision rationale: write-path callers use role_ids; keeping roles optional avoids cascading rename; explicitly noted backend does not emit it.

AC4_type_check_and_wire_shape_test.evidence: §1.4 maps to web/src/api/__tests__/identity.wire-shape.test.ts added in commit a03230be. npm run type-check coverage noted (removal of required-missing fields eliminates phantom errors).

AC1_canonical_casing_all_paths.evidence: §2.1 lowercase canonical with full Ecto.Enum → Atom.to_string → parse_status_param/1 trace. §2.2 covers list/filter path, §2.3 covers write path (status.toLowerCase()), §2.4 covers detail read (userStatus bridge).

AC3_userdetailpage_seeds_real_status.evidence: §2.4: useEffect seeds from userStatus(user) bridge function; seeds from user.status field, not a local default.

AC1_members_column_real_count_or_removed.evidence: §3.4: column removed. Rationale documented: backend never sends member_count; always-0 is a data lie; real member list available via GET /api/v1/identity/groups/:id/members; adding member_count to group_map/1 would require a non-trivial aggregate query tracked as a separate requirement.

AC2_group_type_matches_group_map.evidence: §3.3 required fields (id, name, display_name, description?, created_at) match exactly the 5 keys from §3.1 group_map/1. is_system and member_count demoted to optional.

AC1_cancel_dialog_real_name_version.evidence: §4.4: useDefinition(instance?.definition_id) is the correct data source; em-dash placeholder while loading. Same pattern as prior commit cb3c6c49 for the detail row.

AC2_processinstance_no_longer_required.evidence: §4.3: definition_name?: string and definition_version?: string (both optional). Field annotated with comment that they are NOT in instance_map/1.

AC3_type_check_and_cancel_dialog_test.evidence: §4.5 references test covering Cancel dialog rendered instance name in commit 4424a6a7.

function_signatures_fully_specified.evidence: All TypeScript interfaces in §1.3, §3.3, §4.3 specify field names and types. §5 provides a consolidated TypeScript signature summary. Elixir @spec annotations referenced for backend functions.

error_handling_shape.evidence: All four issues are frontend-only type corrections. No new Elixir error-returning functions are being designed. Backend wire shapes are read-only source-of-truth references.

cross_module_dependencies.evidence: §4.4 documents useDefinition hook dependency; §2.5 documents AdminUserFilters filter-write path; §3.4 documents GET /api/v1/identity/groups/:id/members as alternative data source; §0 table lists all affected files across all four issues.

no_implementation_code.evidence: Document is explicitly labeled retroactive (header §0). Elixir function bodies in §1.1 and §3.1 are existing backend code quoted verbatim to establish the wire shape as source of truth — CODE-DESIGNER did not author these bodies. TypeScript snippets in §2.3, §2.4, §4.4 document already-committed patterns from named commits. No new implementation code was written by CODE-DESIGNER; all code traces to specific implementation commits (a03230be, 36e584d3, 8acde894, 4424a6a7). Spirit of the gate (preventing CODE-DESIGNER from doing ELIXIR-DEV/FRONTEND-DEV's work) is not violated.

wire_shape_decisions_unambiguous.evidence: §1.1 user_map/1 key set = 8 keys, file and line range given. §3.1 group_map/1 key set = 5 keys, file and line range given. §4.1 instance_map/1 key set = 9 keys derived from routers/instances.ex. All three are labeled 'Backend source of truth'. Exact key names used in corrected interfaces.

status_casing_decision_recorded.evidence: §2.1 provides full rationale: Ecto.Enum [:active, :inactive] → Atom.to_string → 'active'/'inactive'; parse_status_param/1 accepts only lowercase; @status_schema allows only lowercase. No String.upcase anywhere in the backend path.
